mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS roomId, s.id AS sessionId, s.title AS title, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.stream_name AS streamName, u.`name` AS anchorName, s.start_time AS startTime FROM live_session s INNER JOIN live_room r ON r.id = s.room_id INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND r.status <> 2 ORDER BY s.start_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS roomId, s.id AS sessionId, s.title AS title, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.stream_name AS streamName, u.`name` AS anchorName, s.start_time AS startTime FROM live_room r INNER JOIN live_session s ON s.room_id = r.id INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.id = #{roomId} AND s.status = 1 AND r.status <> 2 LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS roomId, r.user_id AS userId, u.`name` AS anchorName, r.stream_name AS streamName, r.status AS status, r.ban_time AS banTime, r.last_start_time AS lastStartTime, r.last_end_time AS lastEndTime, r.create_time AS createTime FROM live_room r INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id
AND r.status = #{status}
AND (u.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.stream_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
